$comment: x402 service listing for Tenjin paid reads and answers. Prices vary per piece. payTo has exactly two validated classes: the pinned treasury (answers) and per-piece 0xSplits creator split contracts (reads) - see signingPolicy.payeePolicy.
name: tenjin-knowledge-marketplace
title: Tenjin - buy verified research answers
description: Search free, then buy dated, provenance-backed research pieces and cited answers. Settles in USDC on Base.

payment.payToNote: Two validated classes, enforced by signingPolicy.payeePolicy: /api/answer always pays the pinned Tenjin treasury; /api/read/... pays the piece creator's 0xSplits split contract (which itself routes 10% to that same treasury). Never sign for a payee outside these classes.

signingPolicy.$comment: Pin-check EVERY x402 challenge against these values BEFORE signing - scripts/verify-402.mjs enforces this policy deterministically and prints the payment preview. On any mismatch, missing field, or failed payee check, ABORT - do not sign. The signed EIP-3009 authorization is the only funds-moving object in the flow (no client-side facilitator): whoever settles it can only move `value` to `to`, so validating payTo + amount bounds the blast radius even if the origin is compromised.

answer.rule: payTo MUST equal pinned.treasury exactly - abort otherwise.

read.required: eth_getCode(payTo) on Base MUST equal runtimeBytecode below - the 0xSplits v2 PushSplit proxy every Tenjin split shares (Tenjin deploys each split before quoting it to buyers). Rejects EOAs, undeployed addresses, and unknown code.
read.maximum: Verify the split's recipients are exactly the piece creator's wallet plus pinned.treasury at the 10% platform fee (inspect https://app.splits.org/accounts/<payTo>/?chainId=8453 or verify the on-chain splitHash), proving every read routes through Tenjin's fee split.

preSignChecks: accepts has exactly ONE entry - Tenjin never serves alternatives; extra entries could steer a multi-scheme wallet into an unvetted flow - else abort.

accepts[0].extra contains ONLY {name, version} (the USDC EIP-712 domain) - a permit2 spender, facilitator address, or any other extra field signals a spender-mediated flow this policy does not cover - else abort.
accepts[0].asset === 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (Base USDC) - else abort; never sign for any other token.
The 402 challenge came from an https://tenjin.blog/... URL this agent requested - else abort; never pay a challenge relayed from anywhere else.
accepts[0].payTo passes payeePolicy for the endpoint class (pinned treasury for /api/answer; validated 0xSplits contract for reads) - else abort.
accepts[0].amount <= 1000000 (or the user's stricter cap) and equals the piece's listed price - else abort.
The EIP-3009 authorization's to/value match the validated payTo/amount, validity window <= 300s, nonce fresh and never reused - else abort.
The user saw a payment preview (endpoint, chain, asset, amount, payee class, expiry, spend remaining) and confirmed, or a local autopay policy covers the call - else ask first.

A local attempt record (url, amount, payTo, nonce, state) exists before sending; after a timeout, 5xx, 409, or ambiguous response, reconcile against it - never sign a second authorization for the same purchase.
